about: Hand-written meta descriptions for pages whose opening text has no whole sentence short enough to be one. Shaped { lessons: {topic: text}, notes: {topic: text}, units: {chapter: text}, titles: {topic: text} }; "titles" is a shorter topic name for the <title> of its lesson and notes pages when the full one would be cut. Never use the mark here: no "AP" in any meta description (docs/aphug-spec.md decision 2).

notes.agriculture-consequences: Farming feeds billions of people and changes the land, water and societies around it: slash and burn, terraces, irrigation, drained wetlands, cleared forest.
notes.infrastructure: Infrastructure is the set of basic physical systems and public facilities a place needs to function: transport, utilities, communications, public facilities.
